answer: Build trust like a rope bridge across a canyon: each new plank is an attestation that must be tied to two already load-bearing anchors chosen by a per-epoch beacon the builder cannot predict. A sybil can weave ivory-fine fake accounts cheaply, but planks only hold when the anchors are genuinely distant on the graph; short hops between clones collapse the span, so farming N credible lanes forces buying N real, independently matured endpoints - cost that grows faster than any budget.
